description: This file defines the TemplateVariable class, which extends TempNameExpression in the Twig templating engine. It provides methods to retrieve and compile variable names within templates, handling special cases like '_self'.

classes.name: TemplateVariable
classes.description: A class representing a template variable in Twig, capable of retrieving its name and compiling itself into PHP code, with special handling for '_self'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the variable name, generating one with the compiler if it is not already set.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the variable into PHP code, handling the special case where the name is '_self' to reference '$this'.
